prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Replace the flat quadratic balance term with a smooth hinge (softplus of |ratio-0.5|-band) so the raw partition stays inside ±1.5% without fighting the cut term, cutting repair flips (103/238/353) and preserving whatever cut structure was learned, which should reduce TNS across all circuits.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=-0.952 robust(mean-std)=-0.407 min_case=-0.413 seed_std=0.331 tns_mean=-0.158 all_valid=True
  C1: score=-0.198 dWNS=-28.4% dTNS=-9.4% per-seed=[+0.04 -0.72 +0.09]
  C2: score=-0.413 dWNS=-48.2% dTNS=-32.3% per-seed=[-0.18 -0.43 -0.63]
  C3: score=-0.342 dWNS=-74.4% dTNS=-3.4% per-seed=[+0.14 -0.25 -0.92]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->169, wcut 421->530, crit_cross 0.011->0.098, repair_flips 103->90, changed-vs-baseline 37.1%
  C2: cut 318->381, wcut 1007->1266, crit_cross 0.000->0.165, repair_flips 238->181, changed-vs-baseline 22.3%
  C3: cut 582->608, wcut 1955->1994, crit_cross 0.069->0.001, repair_flips 353->351, changed-vs-baseline 34.5%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: Hypothesis failed: all scores negative, TNS worsened (mean −15.8%). Cut and wcut rose on all circuits (C1 137→169, C2 318→381), and crit_cross jumped sharply on C1/C2 (0.011→0.098, 0.000→0.165), plausibly driving the WNS/TNS losses despite modest repair-flip reductions (C1 103→90, C2 238→181). C3 barely improved flips (353→351) with cut up. Seed spread is high (std 0.331; C3 per-seed +0.14 to −0.92), so results are unstable. Next: tighten the hinge band or add a cut-aware penalty and re-test, prioritizing crit_cross reduction.
